heads.A: labels.tif catalogue traces in the fold
heads.B: SGMC-gap traces in the fold (independent mapping effort)

protocol.metric: official distance-weighted Tversky, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, R=300 m
protocol.detector: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier retrained inside every fold on 10 feature bands
protocol.leak_control: every prior and every detector is a function of the visible mask only (invariant I-2)
